title: The Unwavering Ally in a Trial of Gold
intro: In the shadow of a great prophet, a soul of eloquence and faith was chosen to assist in a monumental mission. This figure stood firm when the masses wavered, preaching against a glaring transgression that threatened the very core of monotheism. When the prophet returned to witness the people's lapse, this figure's defense was not one of guilt but of duty and fear of division. Who is this devoted servant of Allah?
clues: I was chosen by Allah for a sacred duty alongside another, and my role was one of support and proclamation.
I was granted clarity of speech, and I accompanied a messenger to confront a powerful oppressor.
During a critical journey, the messenger ascended a mountain alone, leaving me to watch over the people.
In their absence, the people crafted a golden image, and I pleaded with them to remain faithful, but they refused my counsel.
When the messenger returned, filled with anger and grief, I was seized, but I explained that I had been overpowered and feared causing discord among them.
I am the prophet who stood beside Musa, my brother, sharing his burden and remaining steadfast against idolatry.
